name: Aanya Sharma
bio: I ship clean code and drink excessive amounts of chai. Looking for a high-velocity team that wants to build something production-ready before the final buzzer.

prompts.question: My hackathon superpower
prompts.answer: Whipping up an entire auth and responsive dashboard flow in under 4 hours.

prompts.question: Swipe right if
prompts.answer: You care about clean UX just as much as resilient backend architecture.

name: Diya Patel
bio: Turning raw LLMs into practical, low-latency agent workflows. Here to build real intelligence, not just basic API wrappers.

prompts.question: Typical hackathon role
prompts.answer: Prompt architect, fine-tuner, and whatever keeps our model inferences sub-second.

prompts.question: Looking for
prompts.answer: A strong frontend dev who can turn my JSON outputs into an award-winning UI.

name: Ananya Iyer
bio: Judges rate on presentation and polish first. I make sure our project looks like a seed-funded startup before the 3-minute pitch.

prompts.question: The secret to winning pitches
prompts.answer: Micro-interactions and a deck that tells a crisp, undeniable story.

prompts.question: Swipe right if
prompts.answer: You won't break my layout 30 minutes before code freeze.

name: Pooja Verma
bio: Zero downtime, zero demo crashes. I build CI/CD pipelines, containerize microservices, and ensure our live demo never drops a 500 error.

prompts.question: My hackathon pet peeve
prompts.answer: 'It worked on my machine' right as the judges walk up to the table.

prompts.question: I'm the teammate who
prompts.answer: Has the fallback staging environment running silently on a private cluster.

name: Rhea Nair
bio: Data pipelines, metrics, and visualization. Excited to tackle tracks in EdTech, FinTech, or Social Impact with ambitious teammates.

prompts.question: What I bring to the table
prompts.answer: Tireless data cleaning, clear metric proofs for our business pitch, and high energy.

prompts.question: Ideal team vibe
prompts.answer: Collaborative, low-ego, and focused on learning just as much as competing.

name: Sneha Kulkarni
bio: Cross-platform mobile native experiences delivered in record time. Give me an API contract and I'll deliver buttery smooth iOS and Android builds.

prompts.question: My hackathon superpower
prompts.answer: Offline-first sync architectures that never stutter during judging.

prompts.question: Swipe right if
prompts.answer: You have a solid API schema ready before midnight on Day 1.

name: Rohan Mehta
bio: I write robust concurrent backends while everyone else is still picking a CSS library. Obsessed with high throughput and clean system architecture.

prompts.question: At 3:00 AM you will find me
prompts.answer: Refactoring WebSocket handlers and optimizing our database indexes.

prompts.question: Looking for
prompts.answer: A creative product thinker who knows how to pitch technical depth clearly.

name: Aditya Rao
bio: DeFi protocols, decentralized identity, and gas-efficient contracts. Looking to build actual verifiable utility on EVM chains.

prompts.question: My hackathon superpower
prompts.answer: Writing airtight unit tests so our smart contracts don't drain during the evaluation demo.

prompts.question: Swipe right if
prompts.answer: Your project concept solves an actual problem instead of slapping blockchain on things for hype.

name: Devansh Gupta
bio: Red teamer by heart, builder by night. I ensure our hackathon app isn't leaking credentials, vulnerable to injection, or susceptible to auth bypass.

prompts.question: What I bring to the squad
prompts.answer: Pentesting the product, hardening our endpoints, and nailing technical security questions from judges.

prompts.question: Swipe right if
prompts.answer: You want your platform demo to stand up to ruthless judge scrutiny.

name: Arjun Singhania
bio: 3D web graphics, immersive canvas animations, and reactive interfaces. If your demo needs an undeniable 'wow' factor, ping me.

prompts.question: My hackathon superpower
prompts.answer: Implementing smooth WebGL / Three.js visuals that make judges stop scrolling.

prompts.question: Ideal teammate
prompts.answer: A backend partner who provides crisp Swagger/REST docs with zero ambiguity.

name: Kabir Sen
bio: Bridging physical hardware with cloud backends. Hardware track veterans know that physical live demos win crowds when executed properly.

prompts.question: In my backpack right now
prompts.answer: Soldering iron, 3 microcontroller boards, a multimeter, and backup breadboards.

prompts.question: Swipe right if
prompts.answer: You want to build an IoT or hardware-integrated system that actually interacts with reality.

name: Varun Joshi
bio: Great code loses to average code with an incredible pitch every single time. I handle product vision, timing, judge psychology, and the final demo delivery.

prompts.question: The secret to winning pitches
prompts.answer: Opening with a compelling real-world problem and delivering a live demo in under 90 seconds.

prompts.question: Swipe right if
prompts.answer: You want to build the engine while I make sure everyone buys the car.
